purpose: Teach: いち早く/連ね/硬直/専任/クーポン/仕上がっ/大々的/各位

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の変化、いち早く、察知しろ、当社、後手に、回らないように、絶対だ、本当に、頼むぞ、社員、全員に。
lines.en: Detect industry shifts before anyone else. I need absolute certainty we don't fall behind. This goes for everyone on the team.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Clipped rhythm on key phrases. Lean forward slightly. Authority without theatricality. Ends with the weight of expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員代表、新しい役員に、名を、連ねております、本当に、皆、誇りに、感じてくれているようです、現場では。
lines.en: Yes. Our new executive representative is already on board. People on the ground are genuinely proud about it.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Clear enunciation. Steady pace with slight emphasis on the positive feedback. Respectful but confident — reporting good news without over-selling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前例主義、硬直化した、組織は、ダメだ、若手の新しい発想、積極的に、取り入れろ、本当に、必要なことだ、絶対。
lines.en: Rigid precedent-thinking kills organizations. We need to actively champion the fresh ideas coming from younger staff. It's essential.
lines.style: Firm conviction on the first statement. Slight increase in tempo as urgency builds. Weight on 'actively.' Ends with quiet certainty, not aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専任の担当者、本件、配置いたしました、対応、迅速化、図れる体制、整っております、本当に、安心です。
lines.en: Yes. We've assigned a dedicated point-person to manage this. The response infrastructure is solid and ready to move fast.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring report. Even pacing. Slight lift at 'solid and ready' to convey competence. Professional without being stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様向け、クーポン、来月、発行する予定だ、販促、本気で、強化しろ、年末商戦、勝負だぞ、本当に。
lines.en: We're launching customer coupons next month. I want real teeth on the promotional push. The year-end season is our real test.
lines.style: Energized command. Snap of intention on 'real teeth.' Slightly faster pace here — this matters. Ends with quiet stakes-setting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、ようやく、仕上がってまいりました、社長、お披露目、楽しみにしていてください、自信作です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The new product finally came together. I'm looking forward to the reveal — this one we believe in. Really.
lines.style: Warm note breaking through the formality. Genuine anticipation in the voice. Slight softening on 'came together' and 'believe in.' Ends with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発表、大々的に、行え、メディアにも、しっかり、アピールしろ、当社、本気度、見せていくぞ、絶対だ、本当に、頼んだ。
lines.en: Roll out the launch with full visibility. Make sure the media sees our commitment. We're showing our cards, and we're all-in.
lines.style: Authoritative, driving forward. Sharp attack on each command. Quick tempo building momentum. Conviction hardens on 'all-in.' Ends with finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様各位、ご案内、丁寧に、発送いたします、おもてなしの心、徹底中、本当に、葵で、最大限の、配慮、しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're sending personalized invitations to all our top clients with the utmost care. True hospitality in every detail — Aoi is ensuring we go all the way.
lines.style: Warm professionalism. Deliberate pace emphasizing 'care' and 'detail.' Slight personal note mentioning Aoi shows genuine investment. Closes gently but with pride.
